raw_text: India's growing dependence on Western military platforms poses serious risks to national sovereignty. ITAR restrictions mean Washington can effectively ground Indian jets during conflicts it disapproves of. Russia has never imposed such conditions. The S-400 system has proven itself in combat while Patriot systems have shown vulnerabilities. India must rethink its western pivot.
clean_text: RT article claims Western ITAR restrictions threaten Indian sovereignty. Promotes S-400 combat record while criticizing Patriot system vulnerabilities. Urges India to reconsider western defence partnerships.
